notes.title: Bug Fix update Version 2.1.0
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fix and Balance Update 2.1.0[/h2]

This update addresses a few bugs and small QoL issues:
[list]
[*] Tweaked customer arrival frequency so that the club gets customers a little more frequently.
[*] Lowered requirement for the [i][b]Full House[/b][/i] Achievement/Challenge
[*] Turned off the liquor icon blinking in customers' "want" balloons! This should make serving drinks way easier (or less annoying!) when the club is packed with thirsty dudes.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Beer to be already unlocked and active during the initial Tutorial
[*] Fixed a bug that caused customers to request liquors that were meant for higher levels. (This same bug also caused these liquors to become available for purchase too soon).
[*] Minor HUD UI tweaks
[/list]

[h3]⚠️ Only 5 MORE DAYS TO GET LIMITED TIME HALLOWEEN STAFF! ⚠️ [/h3]

notes.title: Halloween Bash
notes.content:
[h1]Jo Fella's Gentlemen's Club - Halloween Update[/h1]
As we hurtle towards our one-year anniversary on Steam ([i]wow, that went by quick![/i]), it's now that spooky time of the year again and we've got some treats for you during our [b]Halloween Bash[/b] event!

[h2]New Game Features[/h2]
Earlier this summer we launched Boosters that provide what was previously some top-requested gameplay enhancements like:
- Auto-collecting cash and star drop
- Staff speed-ups
- Topless dancers and barmaids ːsteamhappyː

In this update we've launched [b]Marketing Promotions[/b] under the [b]Expenses [/b]menu where [b][i]permanent[/i][/b] promotions can be unlocked that boost club performance.

[h2]Limited-Time Halloween Exclusives[/h2]
Two themed dancers are available to acquire during this event only:

[h3]Trish or Treat[/h3]
Trish dons a sexy witch costume and can be acquired through any Gacha Briefcase, with the highest odds in the Gold Briefcase. Once acquired, the [i]"Trish or Treat"[/i] staff card unlocks permanently in your Staff collection and will remain even after the event ends. If not acquired, you'll have to wait a whole year again!

[h3]Dancer Faith[/h3]
If you've played already, you'll have seen the story that introduces Trish's sexy friend, Faith. Faith can be acquired exclusively in the Halloween bundle in the Shop. It also comes with Tokens and a sexy and mysterious lewd scene and story! 

Once acquired, Faith and the seasonal sex scene will remain in your inventory permanently.

[h3]Halloween Themed Decor Items[/h3]
Creepy decorations for both inside and outside the club are available in the [b]Club Items[/b] [i][b]Decor [/b][/i]menu. Give your club a creepy vibe in keeping with the season. Don't forget to share screenshots of your customizations!

Enjoy the update and thank you for playing!

ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Patch notes for February 3, 2022
notes.content:
This minor update addresses the issue of broken or missing save game files. 

As some in the Discussions have reported, they cannot proceed when their save game file is missing. This update now adds more descriptive warnings to that missing file prompt along with a "REBUILD" button to reconstruct game progress from server records [i]TO BE USED AS A LAST RESORT![/i]

Steps to take if you encounter game save loading issues (either "File missing" or "errorcode 3" error prompt):

[b]ERRORCODE 3:[/b]
NOTE: Tampering with save files can [i]CAUSE [/i]errors and we are not responsible for lost progress, data, or purchases.

1. Locate your save game folder in Windows. It will be somewhere like this:
C:\Users\[b][YOUR WINDOWS USER NAME][/b]\AppData\LocalLow\Evil Twin\Gentlemen's Club\Saves\[b][YOUR STEAM ID #][/b]

2. If you are not a new player, the folder will contain several '[i]savegame.XXX[/i]' files where the file extension will be either "PNG" or numbers instead of the XXX in this example. Rename [b]savegame.png[/b] to something else

3. Identify which of the remaining backup saves is the most recent. It will usually be the file with the biggest number as the file extension. 

eg: [b]savegame.123[/b] is more recent than [b]savegame.004[/b]

Rename that file to[b] savegame.png[/b]

4. Now run [i]Gentlemen's Club[/i] again and cross your fingers. XD

5. If that didn't work, try the next most recent backup save file.

6. If none of those work, rename [b]savegame.png[/b] to something like [b]_savegame.png[/b] and run the game, which will lead to the next error:


[b]MISSING SAVE FILE![/b]

If your save file is missing (either "accidentally" or through the previous section's trouble shooting) the game will halt and complain that the file is missing. 

1. If you were screwing around with the file, spank yourself, put it back, and then hit RETRY.

2. There is no reason for save files to go missing with normal use of the game. But if somehow this happened to you, look for backup save files and follow the tips in the section above.

3. If none of the above works, the last resort is to rebuild your game save from our server's records: Hit the REBUILD button. Some game progress may be lost.
